script_text: Wake up, Pisces, because a seismic shift in the cosmos is about to rearrange your life. On Monday, Mercury squares your ruling Jupiter in the First House, making your thoughts scatter and communication clash. Tuesday is your worst day because this tense aspect paralyzes your choices. By Wednesday, Venus enters a profound conjunction with the North Node in your Seventh House, permanently shifting your romantic trajectory. Thursday through Sunday, the Sun forms a harmonious trine with Saturn in your Tenth House, bringing undeniable career stability and financial clarity. Your love life blossoms beautifully under this watery element. Friday is your power day because Venus in the Seventh House ignites passionate love connections. Tuesday remains your worst day due to the harsh Mercury square disrupting mental clarity. Trust your deep intuition to navigate the early chaos and embrace the later week stability. Follow for daily updates.
